title: Summons to Defendant in Civil Suit

glance.headline: Court summons to appear and submit written statement by 12 November 2026

summary: A civil suit has been filed against Shri Karthik S. by Shri Anand Rao for recovery of unpaid rent and possession of premises.
The defendant is summoned to appear in Court Hall No. 4, City Civil Court Complex, Bengaluru, either in person or through an advocate, on 12 November 2026 at 10:30 AM.

The defendant must submit a written statement and all relevant documents, including the rent agreement, on or before the hearing date. If the defendant fails to attend, the case will be decided in their absence.
spoken_summary: This is a court summons from the City Civil Court Bengaluru for Shri Karthik S. Shri Anand Rao has filed a case against you for unpaid rent and possession of premises. You must appear in Court Hall Number 4 on 12th November 2026 at 10:30 AM in person or through a lawyer. You also need to file your written reply and bring your documents, including the rent agreement, by that date.

IN THE COURT OF THE CITY CIVIL JUDGE, BENGALURU (FICTIONAL)
 O.S. No. 4417 / 2026
SUMMONS TO DEFENDANT
(Order V, Rule 1 and 5, Code of Civil Procedure)
Plaintiff:
Shri Anand Rao, aged 58, No. 9, 2nd Cross, Jayanagar, Bengaluru 560011
Defendant:
Shri Karthik S., aged 34, Flat 3B, Lake View Apartments, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038
Nature of suit:
Recovery of unpaid rent and possession of premises
WHEREAS the above-named Plaintiff has instituted a suit against you for the relief mentioned above,
you are hereby summoned to appear in this Court in person or by a pleader duly instructed,
on 12th November 2026 at 10:30 AM in Court Hall No. 4, City Civil Court Complex,
K.G. Road, Bengaluru 560009, to answer the claim.
You are also directed to file your written statement on or before the said date, and to produce
all documents in your possession on which you intend to rely, including the rent agreement.
TAKE NOTICE that, in default of your appearance on the day mentioned above, the suit will be
heard and determined in your absence.
Given under my hand and the seal of the Court, this 10th day of October 2026.
COURT SEAL
 (SAMPLE)
By Order of the Court
Chief Ministerial Officer
Advocate for Plaintiff: Smt. R. Lakshmi, Advocate, Ph: 080 4000 5566, lakshmi.adv@example.com
Note: Free legal aid is available from the District Legal Services Authority, Bengaluru. Helpline 15100.
